brief.name: Highroost
brief.levelTheme: Skyhook Anchor: the tether station, the final climb. Wardens swarm the decks, a timed beam sweeps the pad approach, and a crusher slams the crown pad itself on a beat.
brief.bossFiction: The roost-mother of the skyhook nesting on the crown pad: a colossal cyber-hen with tether-cable plumage, anchor spurs, a red comb, and one big cyan lens. The last guardian of the tether crown.
brief.rule: Jump her charge late between slam beats, duel each summoned warden, keep bolts on the lens.
brief.tell: Crouch and red flash for 800ms means a 378px charge; gold flash and rear-up for 600ms births one warden.
brief.safeResponse: Plant on the pace, strafe the telegraph, jump as the charge leaves, gun down the newborn before it spreads, never stand under a rising slam.
brief.enrage: Below half HP she rests shorter and births 30% faster with the same charge speed, tinted purple with an ENRAGED banner.
brief.defeat: Explosion, HIGHROOST DOWN banner, crown shield opens. Summoned adds dissolve. Wounds persist through player death.
